[[File:The_Negs.jpg|thumb|The Negs]]
'''The Negs''' were a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that included the westernmost parts of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]; as these areas lay west of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] coordinates (with [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] marking zero), they were assigned a negative first digit.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The region was west of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]], and bordered to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]; further exploration was prevented by [[Hyperspace anomaly/Legends|hyperspace anomalies]] and no [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] could be scouted. It contained the [[Farlax sector/Legends|Farlax sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

Highlighted with their negative east-west coordinate number, these [[Planet/Legends|planets]] were perpetually viewed as second-class, even those within the Core Worlds.<ref name="TEA" />
